name: Speaker EQ
author: jackzasian
description: Measured per-device PipeWire EQ: menu entries and a hotkey for omarchy-eq profile switching, automatic per-output switching, AutoEq preset fetch/import, the curve TUI, re-measurement and diagnostics.

barWidget.description: Bar item showing the active EQ profile for the current output; popup lists every profile that output actually has and toggles automatic per-output switching.
